key_claims.claim: Thoracoamniotic shunting in macrocystic CPAM reduces lesion size but is associated with lower survival and higher prematurity compared to expectant management; CVR greater than 2 and hydrops are the dominant mortality predictors
O/E-LHR in left-sided CDH is overestimated by approximately 11% when the lung is probe-proximal versus probe-distal, causing systematic severity misclassification
FGR fetuses demonstrate consistent cardiac dysfunction across multiple parameters including altered geometry, impaired diastolic function, and reduced global function
After increased NT of 3.5mm or greater, 82% of pregnancies continuing post-normal genetic and structural workup result in healthy live births; termination without testing increases with NT thickness
In CHD fetuses with systemic outflow obstruction, lower MCA-PI paradoxically associates with better 2-year neurodevelopmental outcomes
